content.text: i have 3 themes as liquid glass, black and white, can we use standard names? tel me first

Yes. Label the choices **Light** (white), **Dark** (black), and **Liquid Glass**. Call the setting **Appearance**.

“Light” and “Dark” are the usual names for white and black UI modes; “Liquid Glass” names the material style. I’d keep the existing stored values unchanged and update only the labels.

I’ll update the user-facing appearance labels to **Light**, **Dark**, and **Liquid Glass**, while keeping the stored config values and behavior intact. I’ll first locate every visible label so the terminology stays consistent.
